title: Alternate Data Streams Query Parsing Error
problem: alternateDataStreams tool fails when querying NTFS alternate data streams using Get-Item -Stream syntax
evidence: Command syntax error in filter parsing
Tool returns no results instead of ADS list
cause: PowerShell -Stream parameter requires proper syntax context. Current command structure invalid for NTFS ADS enumeration

recommended_actions.action: Use Get-Item (Provider) syntax with corrected stream enumeration
